description: Source code for a JSON writer utility with test cases and scripting capabilities, including functions for creating JSON objects and arrays, and a command-line interface for testing and scripting JSON output.

methods.name: make_obj1
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with string, integer, and boolean fields, optionally pretty-printed.

methods.name: make_obj2
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with various integer fields, optionally pretty-printed.

methods.name: make_obj3
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with large integer fields, optionally pretty-printed.

methods.name: make_obj4
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with boolean and null fields, optionally pretty-printed.

methods.name: make_obj5
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with a string key containing escape sequences, optionally pretty-printed.

methods.name: make_obj6
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with a double value, optionally pretty-printed.

methods.name: make_arr1
methods.description: Creates a JSON array with string, integer, and boolean elements, optionally pretty-printed.

methods.name: make_arr2
methods.description: Creates a JSON array with various integer elements, optionally pretty-printed.

methods.name: make_arr3
methods.description: Creates a JSON array with large integer elements, optionally pretty-printed.

methods.name: make_arr4
methods.description: Creates a JSON array with boolean and null elements, optionally pretty-printed.

methods.name: make_nest1
methods.description: Creates a nested JSON object containing other JSON objects and arrays.

methods.name: make_inline1
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with inline nested objects and arrays, with optional pretty formatting.

methods.name: make_inline2
methods.description: Creates a nested JSON array with inline arrays and objects, with optional pretty formatting.

methods.name: make_mixed1
methods.description: Creates a JSON object combining a compact object and a pretty array, demonstrating mixed formatting.

methods.name: unit_tests
methods.description: Runs regression tests on JSON creation functions to verify correctness in both compact and pretty formats.

methods.name: cmp
methods.description: Compares generated JSON output with expected strings and reports errors.

methods.name: cmd__json_writer
methods.description: Main command-line interface for the JSON writer, supporting unit tests, pretty formatting, and scripted JSON generation.
